findings.message: The proposed recipe removes tini from stage-packages (line 21 in before), but the service command on line 14 still explicitly invokes /usr/bin/tini. Evidence confirms tini is not present in the final filesystem and is supplied by no other means. This causes a runtime failure: Pebble cannot execute the service. Restore tini to stage-packages or update the service command.

summary: Trigger commit updated from 000c to 000d. Source recipes differ: proposed recipe removes tini from stage-packages while unchanged service command still requires /usr/bin/tini, causing runtime failure.
